findings.why_it_is_a_defect: The task is discarded and cannot be cancelled on replacement or teardown; its capture can retain the view model.
findings.recommended_change: Store/cancel the task on replacement and teardown and use an explicit lifetime-safe capture policy.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Repeated refreshes can complete out of order and publish stale messages without request identity gating.
findings.recommended_change: Use latest-request-wins generation/task identity before committing messages.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Errors and cancellation become an empty list, masking failure and erasing valid messages.
findings.recommended_change: Handle cancellation separately and represent failure explicitly or preserve last-known data per product contract.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Confirmed failure-to-empty conflation; product contract is unknown.

controls_not_defects: The stored-task cancellation pattern in OwnedMessageViewModel is the control case.
unknowns: Retry cancellation policy, transport isolation, and loading/error contract are unspecified.
